Hi Sarah / Alex / Ops team,

Thanks for the quick sync interest — we hear similar constraints from other customers and thought a short cross-org mini‑webinar (20 minute demo + 10 minute Q&A) might be helpful to show Redwood Inference's recent batching and routing improvements in production. We want to keep it tight and practical.

Two time options we can host (Pacific time):
- Option A: Tue, Dec 20 — 11:00 AM PT (works well for NA mornings)
- Option B: Tue, Dec 20 — 5:00 PM PT (better for APAC overlap)

Agenda (attached): 20m demo + 10m Q&A. If you have a specific use case or a single slide you want us to call out, attach it and we'll include.

Please reply with your preferred option or pick directly in this quick poll: https://doodle.com/poll/example-timeslots

Attaching: cross-org-mini-webinar-agenda.pdf

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
